eligibility.rationale: Kakao place metadata identifies 알오름 at Jeju-si Hwabukil-dong (33.519127, 126.549506). A Jeju Provincial Council map labels the nearby feature as 알오름(별도봉), and VisitJEJU documents Byeoldobong in the same Hwabukil-dong area as an outdoor oreum walking destination.

facts: Open-graph metadata gives address 제주특별자치도 제주시 화북일동 4504 and coordinates 126.54950610010988 longitude, 33.519127138262014 latitude.
The published location map labels the Jeju-si feature as 알오름(별도봉).
It is an oreum with a walking trail and coastal cliff views of Jeju Port and the blue sea.
The page describes it as a place for couples or families to walk.

research.identity_note: The similarly named Seongsan/pyoseon Aloreum is excluded by the Kakao address and coordinates; this record is the Hwabukil-dong Aloreum associated with Byeoldobong.
research.label_basis: No Kakao rating, review count, or review text was used as label evidence. Dynamic access, closures, amenities, and seasonal conditions were not confirmed.
